name: Best Gift Ever

description.content: You start the Trial with [6] Tokens.
The first time you drop an Item of each type, spend [1] Token to have The Entity consume it and gain an effect based on the Item:

items: Flashlight: Stunning the Killer inflicts them with [Blindness] for [2s].
Fog Vial: Fast-vaulting makes your Scratch Marks disappear [50%] faster for [5s].
Key: You can rummage through each Chest once.
Map: Auras you see for a duration last [1s] longer.
Med-Kit: Healing a Survivor also heals you at [25%] speed.
Toolbox: You see the Auras of the [3] closest Generators.

quote: "If a demon enters this world in the flesh, a counterpoint must be appointed to stop it from becoming too powerful." -Jonathan Shaw
